title: Raycast footer
description: A crimson streak-art slot fading out above a hairline, then six columns of grey links (two columns on phones) under bold white titles, with small arrows on external links, and a newsletter row: a bold line and a grey sentence, an email field with a light Subscribe button, and fine print in a muted grey.
notes: art is a media slot (a crimson wash when empty)
the email field is a plain form with no submit logic; wire `action` yourself
